issues.span: Having been snared by the fowler of the afflictions
issues.evidence: ཉོན་མོངས་རྒྱ་པས་བཤོར་ནས། bshor = driven/chased (bo-kunpal 7-4: བཤོར་བའམ་དེད་ནས; bo-shenga: བཤོར་ཏེ་དབང་དུ་བྱས་ནས); the net (རྒྱ) is the next line's image; bo-gyaltsab glosses རྒྱ་བ as རྔོན་པ་ 'hunter'. 'Snared' pre-empts the net image.
issues.fix: Having been driven down by the hunter of the afflictions,

issues.span:
Yet whoever relies on sleep
Is like an outcaste and a buffalo.
issues.evidence: གཉིད་ལ་བརྟེན་པ་གང་། གདོལ་པ་དང་ནི་མ་ཧེ་བཞིན། is addressed to the same 'you' (ཁྱོད). All three commentaries read the comparison as the buffalo that sleeps unafraid while the outcaste kills others (bo-gyaltsab 7-5: གདོལ་བས་... གསོད་པའི་མ་ཧེ; bo-shenga: གདོལ་པ་དང་ནི་བསད་པར་བྱ་བའི་མ་ཧེ). English can be read as comparing the sleeper to both an outcaste and a buffalo.
issues.fix:
Yet you who rely on sleep
Are like a buffalo beside its outcaste butcher.
